On May 13, 2026, the May World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE) report was reposted to correct an error in the Wheat by-Class table (Table 671-11). The US White wheat imports for the 25\/26 marketing year were incorrectly shown as 5 million bushels; the correct value is 7 million bushels. As a result, the total imports for the Wheat by-Class table were also revised to 125 million bushels instead of 123 million bushels. Consequent corrections to total supply and ending stocks are also
